verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler-based components (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-1) and reusable `.svelte.js/.svelte.ts` modules for shared reactive logic (svelte-docs-12) support modular architecture, and a community report praises the Context system for sharing state as a DI-like mechanism (svelte-comm-5). However, the evidence pack never documents Svelte's actual setContext/getContext API details or DI patterns from first-party docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the context/DI API, examples of injecting dependencies across component trees, and independent corroboration beyond one community remark.
